events.title: Demo Update 2
events.summary: Demo hotfix 2 | October 24 (1/2) Changes since Demo hotfix 1 (October 19).A dark storm now chases the plane after takeoff and speeds up at each island. If it catches the plane, the run ends. Watch for THE STORM IS CLOSING IN!Pigs left behind by the storm die and respawn on the deck. Islands behind the storm clear away.The edge of the sky is now a pale storm wall instead of a wolf army. Fly into it and gusts turn the plane back. A stormy start Watch the crew repair its cart beneath a giant wolf tornado. A falling wolf statue head kicks off the run and lifts farm junk into the air. events.title: Demo Update 0.1.1583: Four Islands, Plane Health, and a Louder Sky
events.summary: Howdy, pilots! The trip just got longer, the plane can take a few hits before it falls apart, and the wolves finally have voices. We're updating the When Pigs Fly demo. Here's what's in version 0.1.1583. A longer trip Four islands. Land in the barn on each island, drive through, and take off again. Land in the last barn to win. events.title: The free demo is out!
events.summary: Grab 1-3 friends, build a plane out of junk while wolves chase you, then keep it flying while wolves in biplanes shoot it apart. Missing parts change how it flies. Falling off is half the fun.Play the demo: If you have a good time, wishlisting the full game helps us a ton. Something break? Come tell us what broke in our Discord: https://discord.gg/DNbjspHMp4
